d:
To celebrate New Year's Eve secretly without their families, the men make up elaborate lies—Taarak claims an urgent train emergency at Dadar, Iyer invents a late-night research assignment, Dr. Hathi pretends to visit a sick patient, and Bhide claims he needs to get an iron repaired.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
